term: factual freedom and conditional plan guidance boundary
definition: Boundary is FactualFreedom ∧ ConditionalGuidance ∧ BridgeOmission. FactualFreedom universally quantifies Fact/Action and any satisfiable set of Descriptive sentences and constructs a supporting Point permitting every action. ConditionalGuidance is the factual/forbidden instance of acceptance-preserving MP. BridgeOmission exhibits a nonempty state accepting a factual atom and neither a selected prohibition nor its factual-to-prohibition conditional, while abstaining remains permitted in every point. The theorem does not assert the existence of a compatible point for inconsistent factual premises.
note: A semantic consequence inside the previously stipulated material-support model. A plan is not a moral truth assignment, and ideal acceptance is not actual deliberative psychology. See docs/notes/carneades-metaethics-reasons.md. No categorical reason or moral realist ontology is inferred.
